industry: Appliance repair (fridge, AC, small-appliance, vacuum repair) — Toronto / GTA

queries.monthly_trend: SELECT segments.year, segments.month, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions, metrics.all_conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.year, segments.month
queries.conversion_actions: SELECT conversion_action.name, conversion_action.type, conversion_action.category, conversion_action.status FROM conversion_action WHERE conversion_action.status='ENABLED'
queries.campaigns: SELECT campaign.name, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.bidding_strategy_type, campaign.status FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status='ENABLED'
queries.search_terms: SELECT search_term_view.search_term, metrics.clicks FROM search_term_view WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS ORDER BY metrics.clicks DESC LIMIT 20

genuine_lead_definition: All three enabled conversion actions are genuine lead categories (PHONE_CALL_LEAD x2, SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM). In every month metrics.conversions equals metrics.all_conversions, so no vanity actions (GBP local actions, outbound clicks, page views) inflate the count. Genuine leads = metrics.conversions.
notes: Account is a recent launch: first spend appears January 2026 (setup/ramp month, 0 conversions on $319). First productive month is February 2026 (22 leads).

March 2026 has no data (no active spend that month) — the account resumed and scaled from April 2026. Baseline uses the first complete producing month (Feb 2026); 'now' uses the most recent complete quarter (Q2 2026, Apr-Jun).
Clean single-campaign Search account on Maximize Conversions with call + form tracking only; conversions == all_conversions so no filtering needed.
July 2026 (66 leads) falls in the incomplete Q3 and is shown for trend context only, not used in the headline comparison.
